messages:
Ava Lin: Noticed a pattern: several interview loops show 'completed_at' set but scorecard.rating is null. This is skewing our hire/no-hire dashboards. Can recruiting + eng add a validation to block submissions with no rating?

Marcus Holt: We should be careful not to hard-block — some roles use structured pass/fail or qualitative notes. Proposal: make rating required for roles that use the calibrated rubric; otherwise show a soft modal that prompts for rating. Keep an override path with a short reason.

Emily (People Ops): Agree with targeted enforcement. Action items: 1) add API validation for reqs with calibrated_template=true (return 409 if rating null unless allow_override=true), 2) frontend modal + override capture, 3) nightly analytics job to surface overrides by interviewer. Marcus, can you scope API change?

Marcus Holt: Yep. Backend plan: add validation in submissions controller. Pseudocode:
```ruby
if req.calibrated && submission.rating.nil? && !params[:allow_override]
  render status: 409, json: {error: 'rating_required_for_calibrated_roles'}
end
```
Will log override_reason and override_user when allow_override=true. ETA: 4 days.

Dana R: I'll design the modal. Suggested copy: "This role requires the calibrated rubric. Please enter a rating to keep data consistent. If you must override, check 'I understand' and add a one-sentence justification." Include link to quick guide.

Ava Lin: Also request a lightweight DB query alert that surfaces completed interviews without ratings so recruiters can triage. Something like:
```sql
SELECT i.id, c.email, i.completed_at
FROM interviews i
JOIN candidates c ON c.id = i.candidate_id
LEFT JOIN scorecards s ON s.interview_id = i.id
WHERE i.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND s.rating IS NULL
LIMIT 100;
```
Make it a scheduled check that creates a ticket if count > 0.

Recruiter Bot: Scheduled check created: "Missing ratings post-complete" runs hourly. Will create ticket if results > 0.

Emily (People Ops): Great. Two more asks: 1) can analytics compute the impact on conversion if we backfill ratings for past 90 days? 2) schedule two 20-min interviewer refreshes on rubric usage next week and include a 3-question micro-quiz.

Analytics Bot: Backfill estimate: 2-3 hours to run a conservative imputation on 90-day missing ratings and produce uplift projection. Will run after we capture overrides.

Marcus Holt: I'll land the API change this sprint and add a metric 'submission.override' to highlight frequency.

Dana R: I'll share modal mock and copy in #design-review. Also adding an optional field 'override_reason' limited to 250 chars.

Ava Lin: After deploy, let's do a one-week quiet launch: warnings only for first 48 hours, then enforce for calibrated reqs. That gives recruiters time to adapt.

Emily (People Ops): Love that. I'll coordinate communications, draft the invite for micro-training (two slots: Mon 15:00 UTC, Wed 02:00 UTC), and prepare a short email template for interviewers. I'll open ticket INT-5010 for rollout plan and attach milestones.

Recruiter Bot: Ticket INT-5010 created and assigned to Emily (People Ops).

Ava Lin: Thanks all 44d closing loop once API patch + modal land and the scheduled check is active.

Emily (People Ops): Closing: ETA rollout start = next Tue, quiet window 48h, full enforce after that. Will post summary and links to training materials in #hiring-toolkit. :white_check_mark:
